for_the_owner: Hardware: EgoForce's TouchTronix glove (12 taxels per fingertip, 60 on the palm, one bend sensor per finger) has the conductive-fabric layout seen in fusionx_sample, not the thin-film glove in hardware entry touchtronix_fusionx_v3. No hardware entry was added or linked; a separate entry for the conductive-fabric FusionX glove would cover both datasets.

Judgment call: AET-TacNet (doi:10.1109/tii.2026.3665344) was added from the abstract alone. Its evaluation data is probably Reach&Grasp (same tasks and modalities, cited in its references) but is not linked in uses because the abstract does not name it.

Judgment call: ME-Dex 1.0 (arXiv 2609.21449, Li Auto) was rejected because its touch is simulated (RoboTwin, DexJoCo, ManiFeel) and the Xynova Flex2 hand run is qualitative only; code is at github.com/MachEmbodied/ME-Dex-1.0. Reopen it in watch/reviewed.json if a real-hand demo should count.

Judgment call: arXiv 2608.14028 (AdvDex) was recorded as a duplicate of paxini_omnisharing because its OmniShare dataset matches the sample's 29-joint glove and 14 cameras; the paper never names OmniSharing DB.
